reason: SGME is primarily a long-term memory and context engine for AI agents, storing conversations, distilling and retrieving memories, injecting relevant context, and exposing shared knowledge through HTTP and MCP interfaces.

summaries.zh: SGME 是面向 AI 智能体的长期记忆与上下文引擎，可保存和整理对话、检索相关记忆并通过 HTTP 或 MCP 注入到后续会话。
summaries.en: SGME is a long-term memory and context engine for AI agents that stores and organizes conversations, retrieves relevant memories, and provides them to later sessions through HTTP or MCP.

capabilities: persists conversation records and structured memories
distills, tags, merges, and detects contradictions in memories
retrieves and injects scenario-relevant memories into agent conversations
provides memory and wiki search through HTTP and MCP interfaces
stores shared knowledge and supports agent write-back
emits care, memory-update, and anomaly events
